title: Mollification extends the dilation law ∫ g(s⁻¹y) dμ = sⁿ ∫ g dμ from C¹_c to C_c functions
statement: Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N that is finite on compact sets, n ∈ ℕ and s > 0. Suppose that ∫ h(s⁻¹y) dμ(y) = s^n ∫ h dμ for every C¹ function h : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support. Then ∫ g(s⁻¹y) dμ(y) = s^n ∫ g dμ for every continuous function g : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (s : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < s → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ
